performance_notice: 纯写对顺序敏感，直接随机写额外墙钟开销待归因，候选尚未通过性能验收。
performance_summary: 首轮 randrw 吞吐与 completion p99 改善，但 seqwrite 约回退 25%、randwrite direct=1 回退 64.3%；反向复测 seqwrite 方向翻转、buffered randwrite 差异幅度变化。直接随机写 active 吞吐接近，tool-wall 吞吐仍低 15.4%（115.520 对 136.571 MiB/s）。
limitations: Completion p99 is fio clat, not total latency.
Wall minus active includes launch and exit overhead, not a separately measured writeback tail.
Both rounds are single-run local WSL diagnostics without host page-cache drop; causality is unresolved.
All original worsening measurements remain published; command success is separate from performance acceptance.
